response.overview: Akshay Sharma is a Delhi-based businessperson associated with AVS Holidays Private Limited, a travel and tour-services company connected with Kirti Nagar, New Delhi. Corporate records identify Akshay Sharma as a director of AVS Holidays Private Limited. The company was incorporated on 17 March 2006 and is listed as an active, unlisted private company. Age  A June 2025 Indian Express report described Akshay Sharma as 40 years old at that time. That would put his approximate age at 41 in August 2026, although his exact date of birth has not been reliably established in the sources reviewed.  News  There is also significant news coverage involving Akshay Sharma. In June 2025, The Indian Express reported that Delhi Police's Special Cell had arrested a person identified as Akshay Sharma, described in the report as a Kirti Nagar resident and director of AVS Holidays, in connection with allegations involving forged death certificates, ticket cancellations and airline refunds.
